headline: A tank full….

highlights: VA Tech Wabag (Wabag)’s long-term story remains intact, with strong order inflows (OI) of INR 18bn (2x YoY), lifting its order book (OB) of INR 202bn, with a book-to-bill of 4.7x.
More importantly, execution on key projects has gathered pace, while projects in the Middle East have witnessed minimal on-site disruptions, thus boosting revenue visibility.
Wabag reported another good quarter, with revenue growth of 20% to INR 10bn, and EBITDA of INR 1.4bn, with margin of 14.4%, translating into PAT of INR 1bn.

Given the healthy OB, minimal impact of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East and improved execution, we expect Wabag to sail smoothly over the medium term; we envisage the company delivering revenue/PAT growth of 17%/24% over FY26–28E.
valuation: Source: I-Sec research, Company data Valuation and outlook Wabag’s strong FY26 execution, improving profitability profile and record order backlog strengthen confidence in its medium-term growth visibility.
